# School Study — Modern School Management Platform & Cloud ERP
> The intelligent, all-in-one cloud platform for schools to administer students, teachers, classes, real-time attendance, fee collections, and notices from one unified system.

- **Website**: https://school.sbci.online

- **Architecture**: Next.js 16 (App Router & Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Multi-Tenant Firestore & Cloud Storage, Sentry 10.

## Core Capabilities & Modules

1. **School Management ERP**: Multi-tenant infrastructure enabling schools to operate in isolated, zero-leak environments with dedicated data partitions.
2. **Student Management**: End-to-end student lifecycle tracking, enrollment directories, class assignments, and gradebook histories.
3. **Teacher & Faculty Workspace**: Streamlined roster management, subject assignments, schedule allocations, and teacher portal.
4. **Attendance Automation**: Real-time daily attendance recording with automated summaries, exportable CSV/PDF reports, and SMS/push notification alerts.
5. **Fee Ledger & Billing**: Transparent fee structures, payment tracking, automated receipt generation, and Razorpay payment integration.
6. **Communication & Notice Board**: School-wide broadcasts, emergency alerts, circulars, and instant parent-teacher messaging.
7. **Mobile Applications**: Fully responsive web PWA and native Android application (APK).
